allowed.label: contract id
allowed.reason: Contract carries its own primary key; Opportunity carries the foreign key to it. One shared key across two entities by design (opportunity -> contract), not a dropped distinction.

allowed.label: product scope
allowed.reason: Contract and Opportunity describe the same product-scope quantity by design (the opportunity's scope carries over to the signed contract).

allowed.label: renewal date
allowed.reason: Contract and Opportunity describe the same renewal-date quantity by design (the opportunity's projected renewal carries over to the signed contract).
